event: World Fisheries Day 2024 — Matsya Mela (Fish Fair), Bengaluru
identityConfidence: MEDIUM-HIGH. World Fisheries Day falls on 21 November; the 2024 national theme was 'India's Blue Transformation: Strengthening Small-Scale and Sustainable Fisheries'. Karnataka's Department of Fisheries marks it with a three-day Matsya Mela (Fish Fair) in Bengaluru featuring roughly 52 stalls, exhibits, discussions and food stalls. The Bengaluru venue for the 2024 edition has not been confirmed.
